cpu_time_definition: User + system CPU seconds for the compiler and its waited-for children; may exceed wall time with multiple emission workers.
disposition: Not adopted: no substantial consistent end-to-end improvement.
prototype_script:
from pathlib import Path
import shutil,subprocess,json,os
r=Path.cwd(); work=Path('/tmp/dewy-source-core/operand-mask')
shutil.copytree(r/'core/compiler',work/'compiler',dirs_exist_ok=True)
(work/'bin').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
if not (work/'lib').exists(): (work/'lib').symlink_to(r/'core/lib',target_is_directory=True)
p=work/'compiler/opt.jo'; s=p.read_text()
start=s.index('# fills o_buf'); end=s.index('# rewrite the used vregs',start)
new='''# Register-bearing fields of an instruction. Calls additionally use ir.args.
const OU_A = 1
const OU_B = 2
const OU_C = 4
const OU_DST = 8
const OU_ARGS = 16
const OU_DEF = 32

o_operand_mask = (ins: Ins) -> int:
    match ins.op:
        nop, block, loop, end, else_, br, trap, zeroslots, vzu: 0
        iconst, fconst, slot, gaddr, daddr, faddr: OU_DEF
        intr, call, syscall: OU_DEF | OU_ARGS
        calli, callc: OU_DEF | OU_ARGS | OU_C
        if_, brif, brtable, assume, zero: OU_A
        ret: if ins.a >= 0: OU_A else: 0
        store: OU_A | OU_B | (if int(ins.c) & M_INDEX != 0: OU_DST else: 0)
        vst: OU_A | OU_B | OU_DST
        copy: OU_A | OU_B
        memcpy, memset, vop: OU_A | OU_B | OU_C
        select: OU_DEF | OU_A | OU_B | OU_C
        load: OU_DEF | OU_A | (if int(ins.c) & M_INDEX != 0: OU_B else: 0)
        mov, neg, not_, fneg, fsqrt, fabs, ffloor, fceil, ftrunc, sext8, sext16, sext32, zext8, zext16, zext32, i2f, u2f, f2i, f2f, bits2f, f2bits, vsplat: OU_DEF | OU_A
        _: OU_DEF | OU_A | OU_B

# Scratch operands for algorithms that need to revisit an instruction's uses.
o_operands = (ins: Ins) -> int:
    m = o_operand_mask(ins)
    o_buf.clear()
    if m & OU_A != 0: o_buf.push(int(ins.a))
    if m & OU_B != 0: o_buf.push(int(ins.b))
    if m & OU_ARGS != 0:
        loop k in [0..int(ins.b)): o_buf.push(int(ir.args[int(ins.a) + k]))
    if m & OU_C != 0: o_buf.push(int(ins.c))
    if m & OU_DST != 0: o_buf.push(int(ins.dst))
    if m & OU_DEF != 0: int(ins.dst) else: -1

o_note_use = (u: int, pos: int):
    if o_first[u] > pos: o_first[u] = i32(pos)
    o_lastuse[u] = i32(pos)

# The common passes consume fields directly instead of constructing a list.
o_note_operands = (ins: Ins, pos: int) -> int:
    m = o_operand_mask(ins)
    if m & OU_A != 0: o_note_use(int(ins.a), pos)
    if m & OU_B != 0: o_note_use(int(ins.b), pos)
    if m & OU_C != 0: o_note_use(int(ins.c), pos)
    if m & OU_DST != 0: o_note_use(int(ins.dst), pos)
    if m & OU_ARGS != 0:
        loop k in [0..int(ins.b)): o_note_use(int(ir.args[int(ins.a) + k]), pos)
    if m & OU_DEF != 0: int(ins.dst) else: -1

o_count_operands = (ins: Ins, delta: int):
    m = o_operand_mask(ins)
    if m & OU_A != 0: o_nuse[int(ins.a)] += i32(delta)
    if m & OU_B != 0: o_nuse[int(ins.b)] += i32(delta)
    if m & OU_C != 0: o_nuse[int(ins.c)] += i32(delta)
    if m & OU_DST != 0: o_nuse[int(ins.dst)] += i32(delta)
    if m & OU_ARGS != 0:
        loop k in [0..int(ins.b)): o_nuse[int(ir.args[int(ins.a) + k])] += i32(delta)

'''
s=s[:start]+new+s[end:]
old='''        d = o_operands(ins)
        loop u in o_buf:
            if o_first[u] > pos: o_first[u] = i32(pos)
            o_lastuse[u] = i32(pos)'''
assert s.count(old)==1;s=s.replace(old,'        d = o_note_operands(ins, pos)')
old='''        o_operands(ins)
        loop u in o_buf: o_nuse[u] += 1'''
assert s.count(old)==1;s=s.replace(old,'        o_count_operands(ins, 1)')
old='''                o_operands(ins)
                loop u in o_buf: o_nuse[u] -= 1'''
assert s.count(old)==1;s=s.replace(old,'                o_count_operands(ins, -1)')
p.write_text(s)
state=json.loads((r/'__dewycache__/compact-core/current.json').read_text()); compiler=r/'__dewycache__/compact-core'/state['binary']
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('DEWY_','SLOPPY_'))};env.update(SLOPPY_LIB=str(work/'lib'),SLOPPY_EMIT_WORKERS='1')
subprocess.run([compiler,'build',work/'compiler/main.jo','-o',work/'bin/dewy-core'],env=env,check=True)
